provenance: Self-authored synthetic arithmetic source bundles; no teacher output or pretrained weights
selection: validation free-generation AST contract matches, then format count, then lowest teacher-forced completion NLL; freeze before test
decoder: greedy bytes, stop at first complete JSON object; no correction or token constraints
limitations: different decoder from plain SBrain; learned copy mechanism explicitly labelled
not general coding ability or unseen-template transfer
rationale: Learn source-byte attention and a copy/generate gate; unchanged independent SBrain weights; no literal parser, forced token masks or repair at inference
training_objective: completion mixture NLL + supervised copy gate BCE + source-position CE on training literal bytes only
